title: Late Credit Allowance, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite Final Credits
content:
A final credit on a lost or stolen card claim of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier or Elite plan carries a late credit allowance. It follows the business days from the claim's resolution date to the posting day.

- More than 5 business days earns 10.00.
- More than 1 business day earns 5.00.
- Otherwise it earns nothing.

Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

| Business days from resolution date to posting day | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | nothing |
| 2 to 5 | 5.00 |
| 6 or more | 10.00 |

*Hypothetical:* for a claim resolved on a Tuesday, a final credit posted on Wednesday earns nothing. One posted on Thursday earns 5.00. One posted on the Wednesday of the following week, 6 business days later with no holiday, earns 10.00.
